name: clearmeter
description: A clean, resizable audio metering app: spectrum, loudness, waveform, stereo, spectrogram, oscilloscope and VU.

extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: Clearmeter meters the audio your Mac is playing.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Clearmeter meters audio from the input you choose.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: macOS routes system audio capture through screen recording. Clearmeter only uses the audio.
